content:
Overview

Laramie is a city in WY with a population of 32,000. Home of the University of Wyoming with a classic college town and Medicine Bow access. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 26.9.
